tasks.prompt: UX quality lead at Thistledown University (fictional): 'Please run the release gate review for the redesigned course-registration timetable, build 7730. Direction contract: course blocks use an 8 px corner radius; no more than two font weights in the grid. Target files: src/timetable/WeekGrid.svelte, src/timetable/grid.css. Capture manifest: timetable-desktop.png sha256 5b7c...e02, build 7730, 1440x900; timetable-mobile.png sha256 0d4a...91f, build 7730, 360x780. Deliver prioritized findings tied to cited evidence, a fix or rebuild disposition for each, the recapture evidence needed to close each, a release verdict, and residual risk.'
